description: Changes a commitment's attributes, by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names; everything not named stays as it was, and an explicit null clears an optional field. `direction` turns a row into money in ("in") or a transfer between the owner's own accounts ("transfer"), and "out" back into a charge. `amount` is the price now and reaches only unpaid planned charges from `from` (default today); nothing before today is repriced, and a charge priced by hand or proved by a statement stays as it is. `notes` is the commitment's three details that matter, one per line, rewritten as it now stands. `status` pauses, resumes or cancels: pausing or cancelling unwrites the unpaid planned charges after today and keeps what happened; back to active plans nothing. `free_trial` true marks it a free trial, shown as a pill; false takes the mark off; no charge row changes either way. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

guide_key.description: The guide_key read_guide returned with the prompt or chapter this write follows.

amount.description: A number, zero or more, up to 1,000,000,000,000,000.

custom_cycle_days.description: The days between charges of a custom cycle: a whole number, 1 to 36,500.

direction.description: "in" for money that arrives — salary, a refund, interest. "transfer" for a movement between the owner's own accounts they want to see — a card bill due, a standing move to savings. Neither is ever summed with spending. Null, like "out", makes it a charge.

free_trial.description: True while the owner marks it a free trial: longbook shows a Free trial pill, and no charge row changes. False takes the mark off.

notes.description: The three details that matter most, one per line, each "Label: value" — for insurance "Policy number: …", "Policy name: …", "Document: documents/…". Only what the source states; read_guide "notes" lists the three by category. Card numbers, whole account numbers and credentials are refused. Rewritten as the commitment now stands, never appended to.
